field.label: China Domain List URL
field.help: URL to fetch Chinese domain list in dnsmasq format (e.g., felixonmars/dnsmasq-china-list)

field.label: China CIDR List URL
field.help: URL to fetch Chinese IP CIDR list (e.g., chnroute)

field.label: Custom Domains
field.help: Additional domains to route (one per line). These will be added to all enabled categories.

field.label: Custom CIDRs
field.help: Additional CIDR ranges to route (one per line, e.g., 1.2.3.0/24).
